text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I arrive at summer camp determined to help Manhattan Cafe recover from all her recent paranormal encounters.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The students, on the other hand, arrive ready to have some fun.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Hehe… Summer camp is going to be so much fun. Where should we go?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: The abandoned cliff? Oh, but the forgotten cave hidden in the mountains could be good too. Hehe…

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text: W-wait, who are you talking to, Cafe?! You're giving me the creeps!

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text: Haha… I don't really get your deal, but I feel like I'm in a horror movie whenever you're around…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I'd say it's more mystery than horror, myself. Don't you agree, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: It's far trickier to investigate an unseen entity than a material monster, so let's hope nobody interferes. Besides…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I'm more interested in what it's trying to do than what it actually is.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We still know next to nothing about Manhattan Cafe's friend.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm usually too busy to do much digging, but summer camp could be my chance…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …Are you all right? You're staring at me.
choice_data_list: This summer, I'd like to… talk about things.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Getting to know her better could open up more paths to improvement. At least, I think it could.
